title: MoonAtlas answer
description: What show_atlas answers, as data: the verb asked, the name asked about, the graph it was read from, and groups of rows, each row a node of the graph with what its line names.

query.description: The name asked about, as typed; null for a verb that takes none.

graph.description: The graph the answer was read from: fresh when the refresh before it succeeded, with the refresh's own line.

title.description: What the group holds, or the node or page it is about.

node.description: The node the group is about, for `what` and `rules`.

id.description: The node's id: file:, class:, module:, control:, doc:, process:, step: or claim: and its name.

kind.description: The node's kind; null for an id no source defines.

path.description: The file the node lives in, from the repository root.

line.description: The line it starts at, when it has one.

note.description: What the node says of itself: a module's one-line help, a step's text.

review.description: A claim's blind review: verdict, cites_support, home_ok and reason; empty for a claim no review sampled.

rel.description: The edge that reached this row from the node above it.

dir.description: out when the edge leaves the node above, in when it arrives at it.

detail.description: The edge's detail, such as the lines a claim cites.

rows.description: The rows this row's own edges lead to: a test's steps, a claim's citations, a section's checks.
